summary: Complaints centre on damaged roads and unfinished town drainage works, with a police-inaction allegation and a stalled CHC upgrade; appreciation is limited to the Har Ghar Jal pipeline and district-wide project launches.

positives.english: Har Ghar Jal pipelines have been laid through the town
positives.hindi: शहर में हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन बिछ गई
positives.basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): road restoration followed pipeline laying under the Har Ghar Jal scheme in Sikandrarao town; the article frames the scheme as meant to strengthen town water supply. Article does not say taps are running.

positives.english: 143 development works were launched across the Hathras-district seats, including Sikandra Rao
positives.hindi: सिकंदराराऊ सहित तीन सीटों पर 143 विकास कार्यों का लोकार्पण हुआ
positives.basis: DNP (28 Jun 2026): Rs 548 crore, 143 projects for Hathras, Sikandra Rao and Sadabad constituencies combined; no per-seat split or Sikandra Rao amount given. ITDC India Express reports them as inaugurated/foundation laid. Launch event, not verified works on the ground.

positives.english: *Every Hathras CHC is to get a mother and child care unit
positives.hindi: *हर सीएचसी पर मां और बच्चा देखभाल यूनिट बनाने की योजना है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026) says a Mother and Child Care Unit is planned at every CHC in Hathras district and that Sikandrarau CHC work will start soon. Planned only, not delivered; no Sikandrarau-specific amount or date.

positives.english: *Rs 59.20 lakh of town roads and drains proposed for Sikandrarao wards
positives.hindi: *नगर के कुछ वार्डों में सड़क और नाली के लिए 59.20 लाख का प्रस्ताव
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026) headline names Sikandrarau; CC road and drain proposals for several wards were sent to the state for sanction, not yet approved. Counted only as a planned fix.

positives.english: *Hathras district plans renovation of all seven CHCs
positives.hindi: *हाथरस के सातों सीएचसी का कायाकल्प होने वाला है
positives.basis: Inference: same Amar Ujala article (22 Feb 2026) says all seven Hathras CHCs are to be renovated; district-level plan, no amount, no start date, and status as of Oct 2026 not found.

negatives.english: Roads sank and got potholes after the Har Ghar Jal pipe digging
negatives.hindi: हर घर जल की पाइपलाइन के बाद सड़कें धंस गईं, गड्ढे बन गए
negatives.basis: Brajanchal (8 Jul 2026): residents say restored roads were not repaired to standard; after rain several roads sank and potholes formed in several places including the tehsil campus. Residents allege trenches were not backfilled and compacted before asphalt/CC work. No official or contractor response in the article.

negatives.english: Town road and drain works are stuck waiting for sanction
negatives.hindi: नाली और सड़क के काम मंजूरी में अटके हैं
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (16 Jun 2026): Rs 59.20 lakh CC road and drain proposals for Sikandrarau wards (including Eidgah Road area and near the police station) sent to the state for approval; work to begin only after sanction. Status as of this date.

negatives.english: Police allegedly did not act on a complaint at Sikandrarau station
negatives.hindi: थाने में शिकायत के बाद भी कार्रवाई नहीं हुई, आरोप है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Oct 2026): CJM court in Hathras booked the Sikandrarau police station in-charge for not filing a required inquiry report; the complainant alleges police took no action after her complaint. These are the complainant's allegations as reported; article has no police response.

negatives.english: A car hit a paddy-laden tractor on GT Road near Sardhla bridge, killing an elderly man
negatives.hindi: जीटी रोड पर सरधला पुल के पास टक्कर में बुजुर्ग की मौत
negatives.basis: Hamara Hathras (12 Oct 2026): headline names Sikandrarao; car collided with a paddy-laden tractor near Sardhla bridge on GT Road, one elderly man died and two were seriously injured. Single incident, not a pattern.

negatives.english: Upgrade work at the Sikandrarau CHC had not started
negatives.hindi: सिकंदराराऊ सीएचसी में सुधार का काम अभी शुरू नहीं हुआ
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (22 Feb 2026): work at Sikandrarau CHC described as 'soon' (जल्द); no start date, approval status or amount given. Status after Feb 2026 not found, so this may be out of date.

notes: AC 80 is Sikandra Rao, Hathras district, reserved None (Wikipedia list row 80, Hathras Lok Sabha). Wikipedia's AC page gives the extent as 'Hathras Tehsil', but Brajanchal refers to a tehsil office in Sikandrarao town itself, so AC membership of the town rests on the namesake-town rule; field-check the extent. Water: no sourced AC-specific negative was found. A 2022 Lok Sabha document (Rajvir Diler) on saline groundwater and distant drinking water in Sikandrarao and Sadabad villages was seen in search results but could not be opened (eparlib.nic.in unreachable), so it is not cited. Electricity, sugarcane/farm, stray cattle and sanitation searches returned nothing Sikandrarao-specific. Positives are thin: only the Har Ghar Jal pipeline and the 143-project launch are sourced as delivered or launched; items 3 to 5 are planned works flagged as inference. The Sikandrarao SHO item is a court-reported allegation about a sensitive case; the complainant is not named. The Sardhla GT Road crash is one incident, and the headline names Sikandrarao. The CHC item dates from Feb 2026. Several Amar Ujala Sikandrarau headlines in search results (market Eid shopping, Ramlila/Bhagwat katha, Kanwariya flower showers) are not benefits or grievances and were not used. Hasayan, Sadabad and Hathras city items were excluded as other constituencies or not AC-specific.
